types.name: Find the HCF or LCM
types.description: Gives two or more whole numbers (or their prime factor forms) and asks directly for their HCF or LCM.

types.name: HCF × LCM = product
types.description: Uses the fact that HCF × LCM equals the product of two numbers, for example to find the other number when one number, the HCF and the LCM are given.

types.name: Numbers from ratio, sum or pairs
types.description: Gives the ratio, sum, difference or product of two numbers together with their HCF or LCM and asks for the numbers or for how many such pairs exist.

types.name: HCF and LCM of fractions and decimals
types.description: Asks for the HCF or LCM of fractions or decimal numbers.

types.name: Greatest number that divides with remainders
types.description: Asks for the greatest number that divides several given numbers exactly, or leaves a given remainder, given remainders, or the same remainder in each case.

types.name: Least number that leaves remainders
types.description: Asks for the least (or greatest n-digit) number that is divisible by several numbers, or leaves the same remainder or a fixed shortfall when divided by them.

types.name: Bells, lights and runners together
types.description: Events repeat at different intervals (bells, traffic lights, runners on a track) and the question asks when they will next happen together.

types.name: Largest equal pieces and fewest tiles
types.description: Asks for the largest equal size to cut, pack, measure or arrange items into, or the least number of square tiles, rows or pieces needed.

types.name: HCF and LCM of algebraic expressions
types.description: Asks for the HCF or LCM of polynomials or algebraic expressions such as x² − 5x + 6.
